source.name: Tanzil Quran metadata (classification and revelation order)

period.heading: Period of Revelation
period.text: In verse 10 (wa ardullah-i-wasi atun : and Allah's earth is vast) there is abundant evidence that this Surah was sent down before the migration to Habash. Some traditions provide the explanation that this verse was sent down in respect of Hadrat Ja'far bin Abi Talib and his companions when they made up their mind to emigrate to Habash.(Ruh al-Maani, vol. XXII, p. 226).

source.name: Sayyid Abul A'la Mawdudi, Tafhim al-Qur'an (introduction to the surah)

theme.heading: Theme and Subject matter
theme.text: The entire Surah is a most eloquent and effective address which was given some time before the emigration to Habash, in an environment filled with tyranny and persecution, ill-will and antagonism, at Makkah.

source.name: Sayyid Abul A'la Mawdudi, Tafhim al-Qur'an (introduction to the surah)
